name: Ratargul Swamp Forest
summary: A freshwater swamp forest where boats glide between submerged trees, best in the rainy season.
season_note: Water level is high June to October for the best boat ride. In winter the forest is mostly dry and less impressive.
avoid_note: In dry months the water is low and boats may not run.

reach.how: Bus or train Dhaka to Sylhet, then CNG or car to Ratargul (about 1 hr)

local.note: Combined with Jaflong in many tours.
Fixed by local committee; verify at the ticket counter.

attractions.name: Boat ride through the swamp forest
attractions.what: Paddle boat through hijol and koroch trees standing in water.
attractions.tip: Pay at the official counter; take a life jacket.

attractions.name: Forest watch tower
attractions.what: Bamboo tower with a view over the green canopy.

attractions.name: Bird and monkey watching
attractions.what: Spot kingfishers, herons, and sometimes monkeys from the boat.

attractions.name: Gowain river view
attractions.what: Quiet river on the way back with village scenes.

attractions.name: Village walk
attractions.what: Walk through a small village and fishing community.

budget.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

mid.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

luxury.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

rules: Do not cut or damage trees.
